primary-preempts-present-alternatives.reason: The first provided input selects the primary Test. Neither alternative guard is evaluated.

provided-empty-selects-nested.reason: Empty is a permitted supplied population for both guards. The secondary guard wins, then its nested detail guard selects the live comparison.

first-alternative-false-body-is-decisive.reason: The secondary guard wins. Its body compares live with retired and returns false. The tertiary route stays inactive.

last-alternative.reason: Both earlier inputs are absent. The last supplied input selects the live comparison.

fallback.reason: All three outer inputs are absent. The fallback declares the Assessment not evaluated.
